usageNotes: Creates a point-in-time snapshot of a remote LXC container managed by Proxmox Datacenter Manager; the container does not need to be stopped unless RAM state preservation is required. Returns a remote UPID (task identifier) — poll the task status endpoint to determine when the snapshot completes before depending on the result. The caller must hold Resource.Manage on the remote/guest resource path.

examples.summary: Snapshot a running LXC container on a named remote before a software upgrade

tips: snapname must be unique per container — creating a snapshot with a duplicate name will fail.
The returned UPID is scoped to the remote cluster; use the appropriate remote task-status endpoint (not the local PDM one) to track completion.
Omitting 'node' lets PDM resolve the node automatically, which is reliable when the remote has a single-node cluster; specify it explicitly in multi-node environments to avoid ambiguity.
Snapshot names are limited to 40 characters and must start with an alphanumeric or underscore character — date-suffixed names like 'pre-upgrade-20260629' are a safe convention.
